up: Show the exact activity values and chemical structures for all compounds tested in assay CHEMBL4808150. Include the compound ChEMBL ID, preferred name, standard activity value, standard units, standard relation, standard type, and canonical SMILES. Exclude rows where the standard relation is not '='.
sql:
SELECT
  md.chembl_id AS chembl_id,
  md.pref_name AS pref_name,
  a.standard_value AS standard_value,
  a.standard_units AS standard_units,
  a.standard_relation AS standard_relation,
  a.standard_type AS standard_type,
  cs.canonical_smiles AS canonical_smiles
FROM activities a
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
WHERE
  ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4808150'
  AND a.standard_relation = '='
